_comment: The layer graph, as data. tools/depgraph.mjs reads this and reports every
import that crosses a line it should not.
Two seams are the point of the whole arrangement:
- the agent-framework seam: only engines/src/praisonai-ts may import
'praisonai'. Swapping in another framework is then a new directory
under engines/src plus a conformance run -- never a change above it.
- the UI-shell seam: only adapters/src/tauri may import '@tauri-apps/*'.
Swapping Tauri for React Native is then adapters/ plus ui/, and core,
protocol and engines do not move.
governedRoots exists so a NEW top-level directory is reported as ungoverned
rather than silently exempt. A rule that stops covering new code while still
reporting a clean pass is worse than no rule.
_ungovernedComment: Top-level directories deliberately outside the layer rule. Listing one is
a decision someone made; NOT listing one is caught, because the checker
compares this pair against what is actually on disk. Adding a directory
and forgetting both lists fails the build rather than passing cleanly.
